newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Thieves take Russian first lady's US medical gift.
newsitem.headline: Thieves take Russian first lady's US medical gift.

text.p: Thieves made off with over $15,000 of U.S. medical equipment intended for a Russian children's hospital and paid for with money raised by President Boris Yeltsin's wife Naina, Itar-Tass news agency said on Friday.

It quoted the head of the hospital in Tambov, 500 km (300 miles) south of Moscow, as saying ultrasound equipment and other implements for diagnosing childhood illnesses was missing when a container sent from Miami was opened.
The first lady had helped raise the funds for the shipment after visiting Tambov during the presidential election campaign last May.
